title.narrative: NL-DCAF Strategic Partnership for Enhancing Security Sector Governance

description.narrative: The Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) provides valuable contribution to DCAF projects in several countries through the five-year strategic partnership (2020-2024) with a budget of CHF 12 million. The partnership focuses on strengthening the impact of the MFA and DCAF contributions to international SSG/R policy and practice. It also focuses on promoting joint learning from the complex contexts in which the MFA and DCAF engage. The partnership currently encompasses support to the five core programmes below, while including regular dialogue and advisory support to enhance the contributions of the Netherlands to international peace and justice.
